name: Is custom window trim available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, custom window trim is available and often desirable for unique architectural styles or specific design visions. Custom trim can be crafted to match historical profiles, replicate intricate details, or achieve a particular aesthetic not found in standard options. While custom work may incur additional costs and a longer lead time, it provides an opportunity for a truly bespoke finish that perfectly suits your home. Discussing your specific needs with a professional can help determine the feasibility and cost of custom options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom window trim is available for unique architectural styles or specific designs, offering a bespoke finish.
